---
name: Nominate a Reviewer
about: For Maintainers nominating someone for the Reviewer role. See COMMUNITY_ROLES.md.
title: "Nominate @<handle> as a Reviewer"
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

_Nominee_: @<handle>

_Company_:

> Their current employer, or Independent. This goes into MAINTAINERS.md.

_Areas_:

> The areas of the project they know well, for example control plane, MCP, or the documentation site.

_Why_:

> A few sentences on their work and their judgment as a reviewer. If they are earlier than the
> typical numbers in COMMUNITY_ROLES.md, say what in their work makes the case.

_Pull requests authored_:

> Links to substantial merged pull requests.

_Reviews of other people's pull requests_:

> Links to meaningful reviews, or a search such as
> `is:pr reviewed-by:<handle> -author:<handle>`.

---

Checklist (see COMMUNITY_ROLES.md for the full process):

- [ ] The nominee has commented to accept.
- [ ] +1 from at least two Maintainers who work at two different companies.
- [ ] Open for at least 7 days with no unresolved objection.
- [ ] Pull request adding the nominee to the Reviewers section of `MAINTAINERS.md` is merged.
- [ ] An organization admin has added the nominee to the Reviewers team.
